limitations: F27 remains a draft PR and is not merged or deployed.
Current runtime policy still requires money_budget=0, so no real provider call or token read is authorized.
The adapter is not connected to browser, voice, Laya or the durable worker.
Exact provider routing prevents model/provider fallback but cannot assert that an external HF account has pay-as-you-go disabled.
Injected fixtures do not prove account access, current model availability, pricing, quota, latency or provider behavior.
A successful chat completion reports token usage but not actual monetary charge, so the reservation remains NEEDS_RECONCILIATION.
Related CAND records remain thematic references and are not automatically closed.
